prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Oak Shaft inventory icon, resinous springy heavy oak prepared to take a ferrule without splitting. Generate one polished grounded fantasy photoreal 3D product render of a long straight crafted oak shaft. Rich warm medium brown oak wood with characteristic ray flecks and bold growth lines with readable natural longitudinal grain, subtle tool-planed facets and beveled cut ends. Plain crafting intermediate, no hardware or decoration. Diagonally bottom left to upper right, entire object visible, substantial thickness readable at 48px, square canvas with 12 percent transparent margin. Studio key light upper left, textured material and strong dimensional shading matching realistic fantasy inventory art. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, cast shadow, text, frame, watermark, hands, or other objects. Not flat vector or crude cylinder.
sourceLookup: Model audit by icon_3d found logs and building timber unsuitable for crafted shafts and shaped handles. Existing itemIconAppearances.ts uses primitive shaft/handle geometry; no genuine matching crafted component model was available.
